topic: A neighbor wants to install a fence
text: When my neighbor shared his plans to install a fence, I listened with an open heart. It’s important, I thought, to understand where he’s coming from, to see the vision he has for his piece of the world. I offered a smile, assuring him that I respected his decision. Before he could finish explaining, I suggested we could look at materials and designs that might blend well, maybe even enhance both our gardens. It felt good to offer a helping hand, to show that we can support each other, even in small ways. We agreed to meet another day, to walk the boundary together, with the sun and the spirit of kindness guiding us.
